text:
oscar_hw: FYI we enabled a temporary H200v2 burst window in ca-central-1 to reduce reservation backlogs after the maintenance earlier today. This is a controlled capacity adjustment + a short policy tweak for how burst allocations are scored.

nina_infra: Config change pushed to infra-config: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/ca-central-1/h200v2-burst-window.yaml`

```yaml
pool_name: h200v2-burst-ca-central-1
capacity_gpus: 28
mode: burst-enabled
burst_window_minutes: 120  # new temporary window
priority_adjustment: "boost_small_after_20m"
note: "temporary; expected duration 72h unless we hit thermal or perf alarms"
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.43 deployed to prod by nina_infra, deploy id `deploy-2026-03-26-1012` :rocket:

oscar_hw: Customer impact: no disruption to existing reserved instances. New Dedicated reservation requests may be placed into the burst window and get faster fulfill rates for the next 72h. We'll waive burst pricing uplift for first 48h for affected customers.

grace_support: Draft for status page/support: "We've opened a temporary H200v2 burst window in Canada (ca-central-1) to improve reservation fulfillment after maintenance. No action required. Billing: burst uplift waived for 48h for impacted reservations." Posting to #support for review. :memo:

tom_sales: Heads up - I'll email top affected accounts and offer credits if they see any regressions. Also collecting interest for a permanent reserved expansion.

devops-bot: Monitoring hooks added: `h200v2_burst_fill`, `queue_wait_p95`, `gpu_temp_p90`. Auto-drain rule: if `gpu_temp_p90>88C` OR `nvlink_err_rate>0.2%` -> convert pool to drain-only and page oncall.

nina_infra: Ops note: rolling warmup in progress; nodes are being health-checked (NVLink, PCIe, BIOS). If any node fails validation it will be excluded from the burst pool automatically.

emily_ceo: Appreciate the quick follow-through. Keep me posted if we need to escalate to customers or adjust commitments. :thumbsup:

oscar_hw: Rollback plan: revert `burst_window_minutes` to 0 and drain burst nodes gracefully. Tentative window: 72h; will reassess after 24h metrics check.

status-bot: Status updated: "Temporary H200v2 burst window enabled in ca-central-1 to reduce reservation backlog. Monitoring active."

grace_support: I'll publish the CS template and FAQ (preemption behavior, billing) in #support. Tagging legal for any contract exceptions.

nina_infra: Oncall for next 48h: nina_infra, jared_sre, and monica_ops. Dashboards: `dedicated.ca-central-1.*` and the new `h200v2_burst_*` panels.

oscar_hw: Thanks team. Post any customer feedback here and we'll include notes in the postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
